name: btw-terminal-drawer
title: BTW 终端右侧分栏
description: 追加批准：终端右侧分栏及历史优先侧问记录入口；当前终端过滤、搜索、新建与历史内嵌恢复，独立窗口仅明确操作；保留 owner/native 协议。 最新批准范围 2+3：跟随当前终端的 owner 内存 UI 恢复与底部跟随/新内容按钮。 最新追加：正常 ESM 持久化、卸载不删除、全部记录跨旧PTY ID、保存失败双语重试与恢复stopped。
creator: Rafael
notes: BTW persistence deterministic verification 54/54, tsc, independent strict architecture1508 and diff-check pass. No real app restart/disk validation; no exit flush barrier, abrupt exit may lose pending final streaming writes; existing native ExitRequested regex failure remains unrelated/unrerun. See implement.md for complete persistence boundaries.
